e.title: **APRA 登记册总览（Registers）**（`apra.gov.au/registers`）：⭐ 站点标题逐字为「**Registers | APRA**」——⭐ 页面列出 **10 个登记册条目**，其中**三个直接是保险侧**：「**List of registered general insurers**」「**List of registered life insurers and friendly societies**」「**List of registered private health insurers**」；⭐ 其余为「**List of registered authorised deposit-taking institutions**」「**List of registered superannuation institutions**」「**List of significant financial institutions**」「**List of non-operating holding companies**」；⭐ 「其他登记册」区另有「**List of disqualified individuals**」（逐字描述 **A list of individuals who have been have been disqualified from roles in APRA-regulated entities.**，原文即重复 have been）、「**List of enforceable undertakings**」（逐字描述 **A list of enforceable undertakings APRA has accepted from individuals or entities.**）与「**List of registered financial corporations**」（逐字描述 **A list of corporations that provide statistical data to APRA.**）。
e.summary: **澳大利亚审慎监管局（APRA）的登记册总览页**：本条补的是**「谁在册」这一面**——池内已有 [[apra-insurance-statistics]]（保险统计）与 [[apra-superannuation-statistics]]（养老金统计），但**缺「受监管机构名单本身在哪」**。页面逐字列出 **10 个登记册**，保险相关三个：**general insurers**、**life insurers and friendly societies**、**private health insurers**；金融侧有 **authorised deposit-taking institutions**、**superannuation institutions**、**significant financial institutions**、**non-operating holding companies**；「其他登记册」另含 **disqualified individuals**（被取消任职资格者）、**enforceable undertakings**（APRA 已接受的可强制执行承诺）与 **registered financial corporations**。本次实测 **HTTP 200 / 322,850 字节**，清洗后可见正文 **14,527 字符**。
e.body:
**APRA（Australian Prudential Regulation Authority，澳大利亚审慎监管局）的 Registers 页**（`apra.gov.au/registers`）是一张**「受监管实体名单」的入口总览**。⭐ 本条补的是**登记册面**：池内澳洲相关条目已有 [[apra-insurance-statistics]]（保险业统计）与 [[apra-superannuation-statistics]]（养老金统计），**都是「数据」**；而**「谁被允许经营、谁被取消资格」这一类名单**此前没有条目——对做**雇主尽调**或**同业名单核对**的人，这一面比统计数字更直接。
**页面逐字列出的 10 个登记册条目**（实测清洗后可见正文 14,527 字符）：① **List of registered authorised deposit-taking institutions**（吸收存款机构）；② **List of registered superannuation institutions**（养老金机构）；③ **List of registered general insurers**（一般保险／产险公司）；④ **List of registered life insurers and friendly societies**（寿险公司与友好社）；⑤ **List of registered private health insurers**（私人健康保险机构）；⑥ **List of significant financial institutions**（重要金融机构）；⑦ **List of non-operating holding companies**（非经营性控股公司）；⑧ **List of disqualified individuals**；⑨ **List of enforceable undertakings**；⑩ **List of registered financial corporations**。⭐ **十个里有三个是保险侧**（③④⑤），而且把**寿险／产险／私人健保**分成三张名单——**私人健保在澳洲是独立受监管的险种**，这一点在多数国家的登记册里看不到。
**「其他登记册」区的三条各带一句逐字描述**（本条全部照抄，包括原文的重复）：⭐ **List of disqualified individuals**：「**A list of individuals who have been have been disqualified from roles in APRA-regulated entities.**」（⚠️ 原文此处**重复了 have been**，本条**照抄不改**，以保留可核对的指纹）；⭐ **List of enforceable undertakings**：「**A list of enforceable undertakings APRA has accepted from individuals or entities.**」；⭐ **List of registered financial corporations**：「**A list of corporations that provide statistical data to APRA.**」。⭐ 这三条透露的监管工具箱值得注意：**除了「谁在册」，还有「谁被取消资格」与「谁签了承诺书」**——即**准入名单 + 处罚／整改记录**在同一条目树下，做**机构风险画像**时可以两边对照。
**与既有条目的分工**：[[apra-insurance-statistics]] 给的是**行业级数字**（保费、赔付、机构数的时间序列），本页给的是**实体级名单**（哪几家公司在册）；[[apra-superannuation-statistics]] 同理。**两者不重复**：一份是「这个行业多大」，一份是「这个行业有谁」。⚠️ **各登记册页面本身的内容（字段、条数、更新时间戳）本次未逐个打开**，因此本条目**只写「总览页列了哪些登记册」这一层**，**不写「某登记册里有 N 家公司」**。
**其余四个登记册各自是什么**（按名称直读，不额外推断）：**registered authorised deposit-taking institutions** 是**吸收存款机构**（澳洲的银行类持牌主体）；**registered superannuation institutions** 是**养老金（superannuation）机构**——澳洲养老金是强制供款制，因此这一类主体数量庞大，且与保险业在年金业务上高度交叉；**significant financial institutions** 是**被认定为「重要」的金融机构**（⚠️ 认定标准未取）；**non-operating holding companies** 是**非经营性控股公司**（只持股、不直接经营的集团层主体）。⭐ 这四类加上三个保险类登记册，正好构成**「一个法域内受审慎监管的持牌主体」的完整切分**。
**为什么「总览页」本身值得单独收录**：它不是名单，而是**名单的分类法与入口**——⭐ 对做研究的人，**分类法本身就是数据**：澳洲把「寿险／产险／私人健保」拆成三册、把「重要机构」与「非经营控股」单列，**这套切分反映的是它的监管口径**；而 [[mas-financial-institutions-directory]] 用「牌照类型 + 计数」、[[japan-fsa-licensed-operators]] 用「业态分区」，**同一件事在三个法域有四种不同做法**。⚠️ 但**总览页不能替代名单**：要知道某公司在不在册，**必须点进对应登记册**（各册内容本次未取）。
**对 RIAA 学生的用法**：① 投简历前**核对一家澳洲公司是否真的受 APRA 监管**（受监管的寿险／产险／健保机构都在名单里）；② 做**跨境监管对照**时，这一页可与 [[bma]]（百慕大发牌与沙盒）、[[eiopa-registers]]（欧洲保险与职业养老金登记）并读——**三种不同法域的「在册」口径**；③ 研究**监管透明度**的，**「被取消资格者名单」公开**这一做法本身就是可比较的制度特征（并非所有法域都公开）。
**窗口状况（2026-09-30）**：`https://www.apra.gov.au/registers` 实测 **HTTP 200 / 322,850 字节**，`content-type: text/html; charset=utf-8`，站点标题逐字「**Registers | APRA**」，清洗后可见正文 **14,527 字符**（含 44 次 register、35 次 insur 命中）。⚠️ **未核实项**：① 十张登记册**各自的正文与条数未取**（只取总览页）；② 各名单的**更新时间戳与下载格式**（CSV／XLSX／PDF）未核对；③ **APRA 与 ASIC 的监管分工**未取原文；④ 「List of significant financial institutions」的**入选标准**未取；⑤ 页面内**是否有按行业筛选的检索接口**未验证。

e.summary_hk: **澳洲審慎監管局（APRA）嘅登記冊總覽頁**：本條補嘅係**「邊個在冊」呢一面**——池內已有 [[apra-insurance-statistics]]（保險統計）同 [[apra-superannuation-statistics]]（養老金統計），但**缺「受監管機構名單本身喺邊」**。頁面逐字列出 **10 個登記冊**，保險相關三個：**general insurers**、**life insurers and friendly societies**、**private health insurers**；金融側有 **authorised deposit-taking institutions**、**superannuation institutions**、**significant financial institutions**、**non-operating holding companies**；「其他登記冊」另含 **disqualified individuals**（被取消任職資格者）、**enforceable undertakings**（APRA 已接受嘅可強制執行承諾）同 **registered financial corporations**。本次實測 **HTTP 200 / 322,850 字節**，清洗後可見正文 **14,527 字符**。
e.body_en:
**The Registers page of APRA (the Australian Prudential Regulation Authority)**, at `apra.gov.au/registers`, is **an overview entry point to the lists of supervised entities**. ⭐ This entry adds the **register surface**: the corpus already held [[apra-insurance-statistics]] and [[apra-superannuation-statistics]], both of which are **data**, while **the lists of who may operate and who has been disqualified** had no entry. For anyone **vetting an employer** or **reconciling peer lists**, that surface is more direct than aggregate statistics.
**The ten registers listed, verbatim** (14,527 visible characters after cleaning): (1) **List of registered authorised deposit-taking institutions**; (2) **List of registered superannuation institutions**; (3) **List of registered general insurers**; (4) **List of registered life insurers and friendly societies**; (5) **List of registered private health insurers**; (6) **List of significant financial institutions**; (7) **List of non-operating holding companies**; (8) **List of disqualified individuals**; (9) **List of enforceable undertakings**; (10) **List of registered financial corporations**. ⭐ **Three of the ten are insurance-side** (3, 4 and 5), and they split **life, general and private health** into three separate lists — **private health insurance is separately regulated in Australia**, which most national registers do not show.
**The other-registers block carries one verbatim description each** (all copied as-is here, typos included): ⭐ **List of disqualified individuals**: **A list of individuals who have been have been disqualified from roles in APRA-regulated entities.** (⚠️ the source **repeats have been**; this entry **copies it rather than silently fixing it**, so the text stays checkable against the site); ⭐ **List of enforceable undertakings**: **A list of enforceable undertakings APRA has accepted from individuals or entities.**; ⭐ **List of registered financial corporations**: **A list of corporations that provide statistical data to APRA.** ⭐ Those three reveal the regulatory toolkit: **besides who is on the register, there is who has been disqualified and who has signed an undertaking** — that is, **an admission list plus enforcement records under one tree**, which allows a crude institution risk profile by reading both sides.
**Division of labour with existing entries**: [[apra-insurance-statistics]] gives **industry-level numbers** (premiums, claims, entity counts over time) while this page gives **entity-level lists** (which companies are registered); [[apra-superannuation-statistics]] is the same kind of split. They are **complementary, not duplicates**: one says how big the industry is, the other says who is in it. ⚠️ **The content of each register page (fields, row counts, timestamps) was NOT opened** this round, so this entry **describes only which registers the overview lists** and **makes no claim of the form this register holds N companies**.
**How an RIAA student can use it.** (1) Before applying, **check whether an Australian company really is APRA-supervised**: supervised life, general and health insurers all appear on these lists. (2) For **cross-border regulatory comparison**, read it with [[bma]] (Bermuda licensing and sandbox) and [[eiopa-registers]] (European insurance and occupational pensions registers) — **three jurisdictions, three meanings of being on the register**. (3) For work on **regulatory transparency**, the fact that a **disqualified individuals list is published** is itself a comparable institutional feature, since not every jurisdiction publishes one.
**Window status (2026-09-30)**: `https://www.apra.gov.au/registers` returned **HTTP 200 / 322,850 bytes**, `content-type: text/html; charset=utf-8`, site title verbatim **Registers | APRA**, with **14,527 visible characters** after cleaning (44 hits of register, 35 of insur). ⚠️ **Not verified**: (1) the **body, fields and row counts of the ten registers**; (2) their **timestamps and download formats** (CSV, XLSX, PDF); (3) the **APRA versus ASIC division of responsibilities**; (4) the **criteria** for the significant financial institutions list; (5) whether a **machine-readable interface** exists.
e.body_hk:
**APRA（Australian Prudential Regulation Authority，澳洲審慎監管局）嘅 Registers 頁**（`apra.gov.au/registers`）係**「受監管實體名單」嘅入口總覽**。⭐ 本條補嘅係**登記冊面**：池內澳洲相關條目已有 [[apra-insurance-statistics]]（保險業統計）同 [[apra-superannuation-statistics]]（養老金統計），**兩者都係「數據」**；而**「邊個被允許經營、邊個被取消資格」呢類名單**此前冇條目——對做**僱主盡調**或**同業名單核對**嘅人，呢一面比統計數字更直接。
**頁面逐字列出嘅 10 個登記冊**（清洗後可見正文 14,527 字符）：① **List of registered authorised deposit-taking institutions**；② **List of registered superannuation institutions**；③ **List of registered general insurers**；④ **List of registered life insurers and friendly societies**；⑤ **List of registered private health insurers**；⑥ **List of significant financial institutions**；⑦ **List of non-operating holding companies**；⑧ **List of disqualified individuals**；⑨ **List of enforceable undertakings**；⑩ **List of registered financial corporations**。⭐ **十個入面有三個係保險側**（③④⑤），而且將**壽險／產險／私人健保**分成三張名單——**私人健保喺澳洲係獨立受監管**。
**「其他登記冊」區三條各帶一句逐字描述**（本條全部照抄，包括原文重複）：⭐ **List of disqualified individuals**：「**A list of individuals who have been have been disqualified from roles in APRA-regulated entities.**」（⚠️ 原文**重複咗 have been**，本條**照抄唔改**）；⭐ **List of enforceable undertakings**：「**A list of enforceable undertakings APRA has accepted from individuals or entities.**」；⭐ **List of registered financial corporations**：「**A list of corporations that provide statistical data to APRA.**」。⭐ 呢三條透露嘅監管工具箱值得注意：**除咗「邊個在冊」，仲有「邊個被取消資格」同「邊個簽咗承諾書」**——即**准入名單 + 處罰／整改記錄**喺同一棵目錄樹下。
**同既有條目嘅分工**：[[apra-insurance-statistics]] 俾嘅係**行業級數字**，本頁俾嘅係**實體級名單**；兩者**互補唔重複**。⚠️ **各登記冊頁面本身嘅內容（字段、條數、更新時間戳）本次未逐個打開**，因此本條目**只寫「總覽頁列咗邊啲登記冊」**，**唔寫「某冊有 N 家公司」**。
**對 RIAA 學生嘅用法**：① 投履歷前**核對一間澳洲公司係否真係受 APRA 監管**；② 做**跨境監管對照**時，可同 [[bma]]（百慕大發牌與沙盒）、[[eiopa-registers]]（歐洲保險與職業養老金登記）一齊讀；③ 研究**監管透明度**嘅，**「被取消資格者名單」公開**本身就係可比較嘅制度特徵。
**窗口狀況（2026-09-30）**：`https://www.apra.gov.au/registers` 實測 **HTTP 200 / 322,850 字節**，站點標題逐字「**Registers | APRA**」，清洗後可見正文 **14,527 字符**。⚠️ **未核實項**：① 十張登記冊**各自正文與條數未取**；② 各名單**更新時間戳與下載格式**未核對；③ **APRA 與 ASIC 分工**未取原文；④ «significant financial institutions» 入選標準未取；⑤ 是否提供**機器可讀接口**未驗證。
